# Glossary entry

Copy the block below into the section of [the glossary](../glossary.md) the term belongs to. The
entry says what the word is and where it lives in the code, and nothing more.

```markdown
### `{Term, spelled as the code spells it}` — {a gloss in a few words}

**Is:** {what the word means in this league, in a sentence}\
**In code:** {the file that defines it}
```
